target_customer: Large enterprises, including Fortune 500 firms in utilities, pharma, supply chain and logistics, planning AI and automation programs
problem: Enterprise AI and automation projects stall because key business rules exist only as tribal knowledge, so scoping takes longer than building.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software sold to large companies; pricing not stated
product_category: AI process discovery and enterprise transformation platform

founders.name: Rahul Prakash
founders.background_notes: YC bio cites algorithms, data and ML.

founders.name: Harshavardhan Srijay
founders.background_notes: Focus on AI and decision-making per YC page.

competitors.name: Celonis
competitors.what: Event log based process mining, adding an AI copilot in Nov 2023
competitors.traction_then: Described as the German process mining leader

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing workflows through recordings and AI interviews and turning them into process maps and SOPs uses LLMs and standard engineering; enterprise security (SOC 2, HIPAA) adds effort.

defensibility.rationale: Captured process knowledge becomes a queryable record, but the method is replicable by process mining and consulting incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Celonis and UiPath were adding AI features in 2023 and later; no source shows them copying or buying Linc.

market_need_then: Enterprises began pursuing AI agents in 2023; founders reported that scoping took longer than building because rules were undocumented, per YC profile.

branding.domain_note: Site is withlinc.com with email at linc-ai.com, so the exact linc.com was not used.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, short declarative headlines such as 'Understand how work happens.'

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies use Linc, including a French payroll startup and a CX automation firm, so the name is highly confusable.

pivots.from: AI copilot for shippers, carriers and brokers
pivots.to: Discovery layer for enterprise AI and process intelligence
pivots.why: Founders found that scoping enterprise agent projects was the bottleneck because rules lived as tribal knowledge, per YC page.

outcome_analysis: Linc began as an AI copilot for freight and logistics, then pivoted to an enterprise process discovery platform, reporting 20+ enterprise deployments and a public launch. No funding, shutdown or acquisition information was found, and a funding search returned only unrelated Linc companies, so the outcome is too early and unresolved to analyze.
notes: No funding found for this Linc; search results referred to unrelated Linc companies (French payroll seed, Capacity acquisition of a CX Linc in 2024). The 20+ enterprise claim is company reported. Competitor list is limited to Celonis; UiPath also offers process mining but no 2023 dated source was fetched.
